title: teucrium luteum subsp. mesanidum
intro: Teucrium luteum subsp. mesanidum, commonly known as the Balkan germander, is a plant species within the family Lamiaceae. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and digestive problems, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Balkan germander include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating infections and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Balkan germander include diterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
